description: This is a test specification file for Playwright UI mode trace features, containing multiple test cases that verify the visualization and interaction of trace events, assertions, screenshots, errors, attachments, and test state in the Playwright UI.

methods.name: should merge trace events
methods.description: Verifies that trace events are correctly merged and displayed in the UI.

methods.name: should work with non-existing rootDir and testDir outside of it
methods.description: Tests handling of non-standard project directory configurations.

methods.name: should merge web assertion events
methods.description: Checks merging of web assertion trace events within the UI.

methods.name: should merge screenshot assertions
methods.description: Verifies display of screenshot assertion trace events.

methods.name: should locate sync assertions in source
methods.description: Checks source code location for synchronous assertions.

methods.name: should show snapshots for sync assertions
methods.description: Ensures snapshot steps are shown correctly in the UI.

methods.name: should show snapshots for steps
methods.description: Tests that step snapshots are correctly shown and can be navigated.

methods.name: should show image diff
methods.description: Verifies the display of image differences when visual mismatches occur.

methods.name: should show screenshot
methods.description: Checks that screenshots are correctly displayed in the attachments tab.

methods.name: should not fail on internal page logs
methods.description: Ensures internal logs do not cause failures in the UI.

methods.name: should not show caught errors in the errors tab
methods.description: Verifies that caught errors are not shown in the errors tab.

methods.name: should show errors with causes in the error tab
methods.description: Checks display of nested error causes in the error tab.

methods.name: should reveal errors in the sourcetab
methods.description: Verifies that errors can be navigated to in source code view.

methods.name: should show request source context id
methods.description: Tests that request source context identifiers are shown in the network tab.

methods.name: should work behind reverse proxy
methods.description: Ensures the UI functions correctly when served behind a reverse proxy.

methods.name: should filter actions tab on double-click
methods.description: Checks that clicking on specific actions filters the actions view.

methods.name: should show custom fixture titles in actions tree
methods.description: Verifies that custom fixture titles appear correctly in the actions tree.

methods.name: should collapse log entries to a single line
methods.description: Ensures multi-line log entries are collapsed into single lines for readability.

methods.name: should hide boxed fixtures and contents, reveal upon show all actions setting
methods.description: Verifies that boxed fixtures are hidden by default and can be revealed.

methods.name: attachments tab shows all but top-level .push attachments
methods.description: Checks attachment display logic, excluding top-level pushes.

methods.name: skipped steps should have an indicator
methods.description: Verifies that skipped test steps are properly marked in the UI.

methods.name: should show copy prompt button in errors tab
methods.description: Tests the copy-to-clipboard feature for error details.

methods.name: should indicate current test status
methods.description: Verifies that test statuses (running, passed, failed) are correctly indicated.

methods.name: should be able to create and dispose APIRequestContext inside Promise.all
methods.description: Tests proper handling of APIRequestContext creation and disposal in parallel execution.

methods.name: should partition action tree state by test
methods.description: Verifies that action trees are correctly separated per test case.

methods.name: should update state on subsequent run
methods.description: Checks that the UI updates correctly between test reruns.
